pr.title: fix(audit): provision trusted Claude audit runner
pr.body:
## Summary
- Pins and provisions Claude Code in the trusted embedded-audit job.
- Maps the existing trusted Claude API secret only into the PAL runner step.
- Enforces noninteractive print mode with built-in and MCP tools disabled.
- Adds focused regression coverage and updates operator documentation.

## Security boundary
Candidate code remains data-only. The workflow continues to execute trusted default-branch code and retains hard fail-closed proof enforcement.

## Validation
Focused workflow, PAL runner, route inspection, packet schema, precommit, and diff hygiene checks.

## NOT_RUN
A passing exact-head hosted audit cannot be claimed until this trusted-source workflow repair is merged and rerun.
